Tiny Trails: Space

Trace a twinkly trail through ten cosmic worlds.

A calm tracing game. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet a friendly star at the end.

Ages 3–6 · Free to start · $0.99 one-time unlock

Play in browser

Plays right in your browser · about 24 MB, best on Wi-Fi

Coming soon to iPhone, iPad and Android.

How it plays

  • Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
  • Ten little worlds to visit. Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon are open from the start.
  • Astro and Zog are free. The other explorers come with the one-time unlock.
  • No timers and nothing to read. Play again whenever you like.

What's free

Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds, with the explorers Astro and Zog.

The browser version includes the free content.

What the $0.99 unlock adds

All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription.

One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.

Questions?

Restoring a purchase, playing in the browser, and more are on the support page. Help for grown-ups
